note: Palau has no central bank or currency of its own, and the bank read there numbers its accounts in the United States' system: BankPacific (read 2026-10-30), FDIC-insured, with offices in Guam, Saipan and the Republic of Palau, gives one routing number for all of them, 321470364, a routing number of the United States' form (its check digit holds under the 3-7-1 weights). So an account there is numbered as one in the United States, a routing number and an account number. Palau is a sovereign state, not a United States territory: this follows the bank's own numbering, not sovereignty. Bank of Guam's Koror branch wasn't read (its site answered with a captcha) and no bank in Palau of another form was read; the Financial Institutions Commission's page answered 403.
